description: The plot titled “BBQ” illustrates how accuracy varies with the number of demonstrations for four methods. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 1500 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, and 1500. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and shows tick labels at 45, 50, and 55 (with the plotted values extending slightly above 55). The Squared-Exponential series is drawn as a dark navy solid line with circular markers and rises from roughly 53 at the smallest demonstration count to about 56 by around 250 demonstrations, then stays near 56 through 1500 demonstrations with small fluctuations. The Tanh series is a medium-blue solid line with circular markers and stays near 48 across the x-axis, starting around 48 and ending around 48 with minimal variation. The ELU series is a lighter blue solid line with circular markers and remains near 46 throughout, starting around 46 and ending around 46 with little change. The LLaMA-2-chat-7B reference is shown as a pink dashed horizontal line labeled “LLaMA-2-chat-7B,” positioned near an accuracy of about 43 and remaining constant across all demonstration counts.
